answer: Sybil resistance here works by making extra identities expensive to keep alive. An agent locks a refundable deposit in a vault before its votes count; the deposit unlocks only after enough distinct peers attest its answers over several epochs. A clone farm burns capital on every unused persona. Graders mark a violet anomaly when many fresh addresses share phrasing, and an ivory audit log of those marks lets the network slash correlated stake rather than trusting raw headcount.
